svg.title: This derives the finite denominator in (AS7); it may grow with the blocking ratio and fixed patch, but never with the macroscopic torus period. The positive numerator is part of the actual step hypotheses. The equality of color and coordinate squared sums above gives precisely this counting norm, with no dimension conversion. Also tint(ei) is the corresponding physical color frame, so the vertical Hessian block is the physical one. Invertibility of tint shows that the zero vertical derivative in (AS1) is exactly the original stationary equation. Thus (AS4), (AS6), the address multiplicity h, and the gap in (AS7) provide the actual initial radius, width, price, multiplicity and gap for (US1)– (US8). Their stationary graph, inverse-Hessian and determinant estimates consequently apply on the same common domain used in stationary integration and the reference chart.
